LONG.title: How the Great Wall of China Was Built (And What It Would Cost Today)
tags: how was the great wall of china built
great wall of china cost to build today
LONG.text:
The Great Wall took 2,000 years and millions of people. Then it was beaten by one open gate. So we sent China the bill.

How the Great Wall of China was built: from rammed earth under the First Emperor to Ming bricks stamped with their makers' names, mortar made with sticky rice, a thousand watchtowers and beacon smoke. Then the bill: what it would cost to build the Great Wall today, metre by metre, plus our own check of the biggest line (the published estimate bills for mountains).

Chapters
0:00 Intro
0:26 The problem: raiders from the steppe
1:08 The first wall: rammed earth
2:17 Not one wall: 21,196 km
3:03 The Ming rebuild
3:46 The trick: bricks & sticky-rice mortar
4:44 Towers, beacons & wolf smoke
5:39 Myth: visible from space?
6:01 The bill: what it would cost today
6:55 Our check: you can't bill for a mountain
8:02 The twist: the open gate
8:54 Still standing

A new bill every week: subscribe so you don't miss the next one.

Sources:
• Length (21,196 km; Ming wall 8,852 km = 6,259 km built wall + 359 km trenches + 2,232 km natural barriers): China's State Administration of Cultural Heritage surveys (2009/2012), via Xinhua, China Daily, Live Science
• Qin wall & Meng Tian: Sima Qian, Records of the Grand Historian
• Sticky-rice mortar: Bingjian Zhang et al., Zhejiang University, Accounts of Chemical Research (2010); National Geographic
• Inscribed bricks: Google Arts & Culture, Simatai Great Wall, "The Text Bricks"
• Qi Jiguang's watchtowers; Ming beacon signal rules: Travel China Guide; Wikipedia
• Yang Liwei, 2003: China Daily; Al Jazeera
• Cost per metre (¥58,800), towers, passes, ¥635B ≈ $95B: Travel China Guide, "How much did the construction of the Great Wall of China cost?"
• Upper estimate ($360B, all dynasties): Lovemoney, "History's most expensive megaprojects"
• Shanhai Pass, 1644: Wikipedia, "Battle of Shanhai Pass"
Our check: built wall only, 6,259 km × ¥58,800 + ¥3.5B towers + ¥100B passes ≈ ¥471.5B ≈ $69B at ~6.8 ¥/$. Rough estimate, not a quote.
